payload.title: Why R23-M0 failed: what we know and don't
payload.markdown:
### Observed
- First FATAL `data TLB error interrupt` on R23-M0 at 09:12:03 [R-0002]
- 312 corrected parity errors on the same midplane in the 10 minutes before [R-0002]

### Hypothesis
- Parity-error bursts precede TLB failures on the same midplane: support 0.68 vs baseline 0.05, lift 13.6 [R-0007]. Reverse direction is weak (lift 0.39). **Association, not proof.**

### Unknowns
- Whether the hardware was replaced; any user impact.

### Next step
- Check the node-card error counters on R23-M0 and compare with the 3 counter-example midplanes [R-0007].
